name: saldio-pos
description: Saldio POS - plataforma multiempresa de punto de venta y gestion

scripts.build: npm run build -w @saldio/shared && npm run build -w @saldio/api && npm run build -w @saldio/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @saldio/api" "npm run dev -w @saldio/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @saldio/shared && npm run test -w @saldio/web && npm run test -w @saldio/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @saldio/shared && npm run typecheck -w @saldio/api && npm run typecheck -w @saldio/web
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build -w @saldio/web && npm run build -w @saldio/desktop
